units.source_text: 比目魚多此一舉的提防，不，應該說是世人難以理喻的虛榮心和愛面子的心態，使我感到無比的鬱悶。

en.t: Flounder's needless caution, or rather the incomprehensible vanity and concern for appearances that people have, made me feel unbearably depressed.

units.source_text: 比目魚當時如果這麼告訴我就好了：「

en.t: It would have been enough if Flounder had simply told me this at the time: "

units.source_text: 不論是國立、公立還是私立學校，無論如何從四月開始，你必須得去一所學校上學。

en.t: Whether it is a national, public, or private school, from April you must go to some school no matter what.

units.source_text: 只要你上學了，家裡就會給你寄來充裕的生活費。」

en.t: Once you start attending school, your family will send you ample living expenses."

units.source_text: 很久以後我才明白，事實上，當時就是這麼回事。

en.t: Only much later did I understand that, in fact, that was exactly how things stood at the time.

units.source_text: 他若這麼對我說了，我會聽從他的話照辦執行吧。

en.t: If he had said that to me, I would probably have obeyed his instructions and done as I was told.

units.source_text: 但是，由於比目魚多此一舉的提防，和拐彎抹角的說話方式，詭異地使我的人生方向脫軌了。

en.t: But because of Flounder's needless caution and his roundabout way of speaking, the course of my life was strangely derailed.
